In addition to releasing its usual mix of reality shows (Project Runway) and original animated shows (CoComelon), the streamer is scheduled to debut two of Disney’s biggest 2026 movies: Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu and Toy Story 5.

Pedro Pascal‘s sci-fi adventure wasn’t a huge hit in theaters, so a lot of people will be able to catch up on the Mandalorian’s latest exploits.
